Iconic EQ Heavy Pistol (w/ Efficient Autosear, Parallax, Pistol Autosear, & Smart Rebuild). Holds 30 rounds. When making an Autofire (Machine Pistol 4) Attack, the user may opt to instead make an Autofire (Machine Pistol 3) Attack to attempt firing at another target that is within 8m/yds of the first target without expending additional ammunition or requiring another Action. Each Autofire Check is rolled individually, but the user suffers a -2 penalty on both Checks. Can accept an additional Weapon Mod (2 Total).

Variant of: Kappa
Category: Super Luxury
Fabrication: DV29 - 10,000eb - 1 Month
Class: Excellent Quality Heavy Pistol
Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Pistol Autosear, Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Super Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
